An Ordinance
further to amend the National Guards Act, 1973.
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part-I, 19th August, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated
19-8-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the National Guards
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

(c)
after clause (b), amended as aforesaid, clauses (c) and (d) shall be omitted.
